ngaap.notes: Adjusted EPS per Table G (results adjusted for disposition transaction and debt purchase); per-share item values from release summary text ($1.04 income, $0.35 charge). Adjusted EBITDA definition (Q1-14 to Q3-15): EBITDA less gains on real estate/businesses, plus divestiture/acquisition charges and restructuring, less amortization of deferred revenue. Aggregates cash gross profit per ton not published as $ (only '+8%'). Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation = net earnings + provision for income taxes (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added) + DDA&A (EBITDA excludes discontinued operations). Hence self-check ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub differs by the after-tax discontinued-operations add-back (0.5); not an extraction error.

check_notes: Self-check results: EBITDA check (ni+tax+interest+dda) is off by the discontinued-ops add-back 0.5; passes once ebitda_bridge_disc_ops is included (Vulcan definition, see ngaap.notes). All other checks pass.
